notes_for_editor: Coordinate conflict left open: the state index gives 47.67105, -115.59675 (matches the brief), while west_us_lookouts gives 47.66521, -115.57655 and cites the weebly page. The story gives no coordinates. The 'WNW of Thompson Falls' bearing was not checked against a map; the editor should choose the point. Two searches found no other source. Height 6.1 m is the 20-foot pole height converted.
